title: Analysis request preview response
description: What POST /v1/analysis-requests/preview returns. This is the UI's source of truth for the draft card: the browser renders these fields, never a parse of the assistant's prose. Nothing this endpoint returns implies anything was executed — preview creates no run directory and queues no job.

can_confirm.description: True only when status is awaiting_confirmation: no validation errors and no unanswered required question. The Confirm control is disabled whenever this is false, and the controller refuses independently of the UI.

executor_config_preview.description: The config the executor would receive, after domain.to_executor_config. Shown so a reviewer can see the public names mapped to the executor's own, and see that nothing else is present.

execution_plan.description: A description of what confirming would set in motion. It is not a routing decision: src/graph.py owns routing, and this plan says so in route_decided_by.

route.description: A provisional reading of the filesystem, for display only.

route_is_provisional.description: Always true. ingest_validate decides the route at run time from the filesystem and its answer wins over anything shown here or claimed by a requester.

steps.description: Read from src/registry.py, never restated here.

gates.description: Where this run is likely to stop and ask. Not exhaustive: a judge verdict can open a gate no plan predicts.
